_help: Owner-editable site banner. Set 'message' to show a red announcement band above the header (e.g. holiday closures, new sessions). Leave message empty to hide. 'until' (YYYY-MM-DD) auto-hides it after that date. 'link' is optional — either an external URL or an internal page id like #availability. Visitors can dismiss the banner; changing the message shows it again. See OWNER-GUIDE.md.
